data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a net loss of GBP 14.933 million for the closed 2018 year of account, indicating a strengthening of prior year reserves. This adverse development is attributed to the overall outcome of the closed year, with general references to major or attritional losses and the impact of external factors on claims estimates. Specific typhoons (Hagibis, Faxai, Jebi) from 2018 and 2019 are noted for contributing to currency shortfalls due to claims being denominated in Japanese Yen.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net loss for the closed 2018 year of account; no gross prior year development figure was explicitly available due to RITC distortion. The claims development triangle is deemed unreliable for direct PYD calculation due to the significant Reinsurance to Close (RITC) process for 2018 and prior years of account.
